objective: Prove: if, for the image C_d of a sector psi, (P2) and (P3) hold for the C_d-characters, then |Hom_psi(pi, G)| = prod over nontrivial C_d-characters theta of |Z1(pi; F_p^theta)|^(dim n_theta), for every finitely presented pi with H^1 and H^2 with F_p coefficients zero; so counting is polynomial on closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 and a bounded number of sectors. Show (P2) + (P3) is equivalent to the nontrivial character components generating a class-2 subalgebra with fixed central part, and check against independent counts.
status: Proved by COPRIME-DICHOTOMY-20261027-001A-P001: (P2) and (P3) at the sector order make the count rigid in every class; (P2) collapses the action to an involution.
title: Pairs and triples of nontrivial characters: the polynomial side for every cyclic action
